summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Pacer Swan SOS Conservative (July) ETF (PSCJ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF over a one-year period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. PSCJ was launched on Jun 30, 2021 and is issued by Pacer.
